reason: The README describes an agent skill centered on structured GitHub discovery, repository and code search, issue/PR search, trend exploration, and repository analysis through the gh CLI.

summaries.zh: 通过 gh CLI 为智能体提供结构化的 GitHub 仓库、代码、议题和拉取请求搜索与探索功能。
summaries.en: Provides AI agents with structured GitHub repository, code, issue, and pull request search and exploration through the gh CLI.

capabilities: Searches GitHub repositories, code, issues, and pull requests through the gh CLI
Filters, deduplicates, scores, and formats search results
Writes detailed reports to a temporary local file
